title: puccinellia phryganodes subsp. geniculata
intro: Puccinellia phryganodes subsp. geniculata, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of Puccinellia phryganodes subsp. geniculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
